task_records.description: [US3] Publish uniquely named workbooks under `~/.farmboy/metrics/reports/` without overwriting prior outputs; create the same header-only table for zero accepted rows and fail visibly on output errors or above 1,000,000 accepted rows in `skills/farmboy-metrics-report/scripts/metrics_report.py` (depends on T015).

[US3] Complete `skills/farmboy-metrics-report/SKILL.md` so explicit invocation within FarmBoy verifies the reviewed source layout and `openpyxl==3.1.5`/`et-xmlfile` readiness before any output creation, runs the source report with the prescribed skill-tools interpreter, explains summary counts and locations, and never installs dependencies or launches another workflow (depends on T001 and T016).

[US3] Document schema, invocation boundaries, wall-clock limits, storage locations, concurrency, warnings, consumer delivery boundary, and explicit report usage in `docs/metrics.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, and `docs/installation.md` (depends on T006, T011, and T017).

[US3] Verify disposable consumer installation and removal deliver the collection helper but exclude the maintainer report skill and its dependency, while preserving local metric files and unrelated consumer components in `tests/test_bundle_lifecycle.py` and `tests/test_catalog.py` (depends on T004 and T017).

Run the deterministic collection, report, controller, catalog, and bundle lifecycle checks listed in `specs/022-local-workflow-agent-timing-metrics/quickstart.md`; inspect `controllers/farmboy/controller-protocol.md` to confirm the metrics-only TOML-read exception is narrow and preserves dispatch authority; correct failures in their owning source or test files.

Exercise the documented live observation path for an exact named agent in FarmBoy and a disposable consumer, then explicitly invoke the maintainer report and record bounded evidence in `specs/022-local-workflow-agent-timing-metrics/quickstart.md` without including transcripts, secrets, personal details, or absolute host paths.

Open one populated workbook and one header-only workbook in Excel, verify table interoperability, filtering, literal text, and numeric signed-duration calculations, and record the observations in `specs/022-local-workflow-agent-timing-metrics/quickstart.md`.
